gen-jetbrains-mono-fs-literata: Sophisticated is the word for Literata, a serif whose thin lines and slightly heavier ones keep the text bookish. And JetBrains Mono, fixed-width and loosely strung, brings the terminal-window attitude that makes the whole pairing feel current.
gen-orbitron-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Noto Serif Hentaigana reads like a classic serif, refined and traditional. Orbitron stretches its letters wide and precise, while the body's gently modulated curves and open jaws do the quiet work of holding a paragraph together.
gen-zodiak-fs-merriweather-sans: Dignified up top, sturdy below. Zodiak swings hard between fat stems and feather-light hairlines, and Merriweather Sans answers that drama with tall, plainly built lowercase that looks big and dependable.
gen-zodiak-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans reads open and friendly, its curve ends held well away from the stems. Spline Sans keeps every stroke in lockstep, so a long page moves along smoothly under Zodiak's heavy stems and wire-fine horizontals.
gen-zodiak-fs-supreme: Heavy ink meets near-invisible hairlines, with Zodiak's dark stems towering over Supreme's crisp, sturdy-looking band of text. Their gap in drama is the real story.
gen-zodiak-manrope: Zodiak throws an extreme gap between its thickest and thinnest strokes, which gets lost if the heading is made small. Manrope keeps its joins full and its curve mouths bright, so it holds up even when the body goes large.
gen-zodiak-outfit: Outfit reads clean and approachable, with curves that finish well before they close. Outfit has no hairlines at all, while Zodiak's heavy stems with barely visible joins carry all the authority a heading needs.
gen-zodiak-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans is monoline and precise, its curve endings kept well apart. Plus Jakarta Sans lets Zodiak's hairline arcs leaving bold stems stand out, so the page has one voice that is dramatic and one that is plain.
gen-zodiak-satoshi: Zodiak brings dignified swings from thick to thin, with a moderate lowercase height. Satoshi sits beneath it with a soaring x-height and a wide-open e, every stroke cut to a single width.
gen-zodiak-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk builds each glyph from a constant-width ribbon, with counters that breathe like a cut reed. Space Grotesk would read steadily over a long stretch, never swelling the way Zodiak's big weight swings do.
